title: QuAD: Quantitative Assessment via Distribution-Alignment for Qualitative Data Quality Enabled by a Content-Aware Multi-Agent System
abstract: arXiv:2610.23153v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Assessing whether qualitative responses collected from semi-structured questions are ready for a particular analysis goal is a persistent challenge. Manual qualitative analysis is interpretive and labor-intensive, while existing automated methods often lack a dataset-level perspective for deciding whether a response set supports a researcher-selected analytical lens. We introduce QuAD, a framework for quantitative pre-analysis assessment of qualitative response datasets. QuAD compares a reconstructed intrinsic cluster distribution reconstructed from responses with an extrinsic, researcher-defined analytical lens derived from metadata. QuAD is structured into a four-quadrant assessment whose metrics are read jointly, from lens-level relations to within-cluster variation, to provide fitness-for-purpose signals for revealing general patterns and unique insights. Because this assessment relies on lens-conditioned inter-response dissimilarity

translated_title: QuAD：基于内容感知多智能体系统、通过分布对齐实现定性数据质量的定量评估方法
translated_abstract: 评估从半结构化问题中收集的定性回答是否适用于特定分析目标是一个长期存在的挑战。人工定性分析具有解释性且劳动密集，而现有自动化方法通常缺乏数据集层面的视角，无法判断一组回答是否支持研究者所选择的分析视角。我们提出了QuAD，一个用于定性回答数据集的定量预分析评估框架。QuAD将基于回答重构的内在聚类分布与从元数据中导出的、由研究者定义的外部分析视角进行对齐比较。QuAD采用四象限评估结构，其指标需联合解读——从视角层面的关系到聚类内部的变异——从而为揭示普遍规律与独特洞察提供“用途适配性”信号。由于该评估依赖于以分析视角为条件的回答间相异性度量（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出了QuAD框架，利用内容感知多智能体系统，将定性回答重构的内在聚类分布与研究者定义的外部分析视角进行分布对齐，通过四象限联合指标在分析前定量评估定性数据集对特定研究目标的适用性。
